_about: The one place that names this project's live WordPress site (WordPress.com). Every helper reads it through scripts/lib/wp_site.py. null means the setup (the wordpress-connect skill) has not filled it in yet: copy sftp_host, username and the WordPress root from Hosting > Settings > SFTP/SSH and the first SSH login. The WordPress MCP is the user-scope WordPress.com connector, so there are no mcp servers here.
